stem.raptorhunt.study_canvas: Frozen raptor study. Drag or use arrow keys to orbit. Use the view buttons and distance slider below. Escape returns to paused flight.
stem.raptorhunt.study_help: Drag the bird view or focus it and use arrow keys to orbit. The mission clock and animals stay frozen.
stem.raptorhunt.study_rest_question: What changes when a bird lands?
stem.raptorhunt.study_dive_question: Where did the wing area go?
stem.raptorhunt.study_glide_question: How are the wings and tail arranged?
stem.raptorhunt.study_rest_copy: Inspect the wing position, tail, and feet. Resume and take off, then freeze another moment to compare.
stem.raptorhunt.study_dive_copy: Compare the swept wings with your last glide. Predict what will happen to speed and height when you pull up, then resume to test it.
stem.raptorhunt.study_glide_copy: Look from above for wing shape and from behind for the tail. Predict how the pose will change during a turn or dive, then try it.
stem.raptorhunt.study_announced: 3D study open. Flight is frozen. Choose a view, drag to orbit, or use the arrow keys on the bird view.
